headline: Price hike: LPG cylinders sell Tk300-500 above govt fixed price
summary: An acute shortage of liquefied petroleum gas has led to sellers charging prices far exceeding government mandates.
details: LPG cylinders are being sold at prices Tk300 to Tk500 higher than the government's fixed rate.
This price surge comes amid an acute shortage of gas supplies in the market.
Consumers are facing significant difficulties in securing cylinders at the official rate.
The shortage has allowed sellers to exploit the market, bypassing government price controls.

headline: 8 police arrest 8 for celebrating Sheikh Hasina's birthday in Banshkhali
summary: The arrested individuals, members of the banned Awami League, Chhatra League, and Jubo League, were caught during raids raids in Chittagong.
details: Police in Banshkhali, Chittagong, arrested eight people for celebrating the birthday of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

caption:
8 people arrested in Chittagong for celebrating Sheikh Hasina's birthday—including two cakes seized by police.

Police in Banshkhali, Chittagong, arrested eight people for celebrating the birthday of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

The arrests occurred during raids conducted across various areas of the upazila on Sunday night.

Among the arrested were two members of the banned Awami League, four from the Chhatra League, and two from the Jubo League.

Police also seized two cakes brought for the birthday celebration.

Inspector (Investigation) Sudhanshu Shekhar Haldar of Banshkhali Police Station stated that the arrests were made under the following laws.

The arrested individuals were sent to court on Monday after being booked under the Anti-Terrorism Act.

The individuals arrested include Ahmed Hossain, Zaker Ahmed, Zafar Ahmed, Jamir Uddin, Riaz Uddin, Syed Nur Hridoy, SM Mozammel Haque, and Azad Mia.
